schema_version_policy_summary: TeamDomain schema v1: the domain name is 'team_domain'; createTeamDomain stamps one schema-meta row per store (8 stamps keyed by store name, fields schemaVersion/store/version/stampedAt) and rejects an already-stamped domain with TEAM_DOMAIN_EXISTS {store:'schema_meta',size}. SUPPORTED_TEAM_DOMAIN_SCHEMA_VERSIONS = [1]. openTeamDomain verifies every stamp in canonical store order: missing -> SCHEMA_STAMP_MISSING {store,expected:1,found:null}; parseable-but-unsupported version -> SCHEMA_STAMP_MISMATCH via assertSupportedTeamDomainSchemaVersion(value,store); corrupt row -> RECORD_INVALID; the backend 'version-mismatch' rejection at open maps to SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH {expected:1,found,seamCode}. No built-in migration: a version-2 medium rejects at open and must be handled by a future explicit migration operation. Every record in all 8 stores carries schemaVersion:1 and is validated by the frozen contracts v1 parsers; input-factory stores (team_sessions, member_instances) additionally run assertNoLegacyFields on the raw input at put time because the contracts factories silently drop unknown fields. Crash model is roll-forward/reconcile (no rollback): a crash between any two writes leaves either the prior fully-committed state or a detectable partial/stamped-mismatch state that open refuses.
